missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Сержант' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. This is an animate masculine noun, here in its base form.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Сержанта' is the accusative object of 'уважают', and for an animate masculine noun the accusative copies the genitive ending. 'Своего' agrees in the same form.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Сержанта' is the genitive after 'у' to show whose character it is. 'Характер' is the nominative subject of the sentence.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Сержанту' is the dative case marking the person who receives. 'Документы' is the accusative plural object of 'отдал'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Сержантом' is the instrumental required after 'с' to mean together with the sergeant. 'Утром' specifies the time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О сержанте' uses the prepositional form 'сержанте' after 'о' to talk about the person. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Сержанты' is the nominative plural subject of 'проверяют'. 'Оружие' is the accusative object, and 'сейчас' adds immediacy.
Strategic focus: Animate genitive plural. 'Сержантов' is the genitive plural after 'двух', and for animate nouns the accusative copies this form. 'Командир' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Сержант' is nominative as the subject. 'Этот' points at him and 'опытный' is the agreeing masculine adjective in this descriptive card.
Strategic focus: Nominative question. 'Сержант' stays in the nominative as the subject in this question with 'где'. 'Наш' is the agreeing masculine possessive.
